chars.FATIMA: a thin 12-year-old Moroccan girl with dark hair in one long braid, wearing a faded pink hoodie and a long grey skirt, plastic sandals
chars.MOTHER: a frail Moroccan woman in her late 30s wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a white headscarf
chars.UNCLE: a heavy-set Moroccan man in his 50s with a grey mustache, wearing a white djellaba over a brown sweater and a big gold watch
chars.UNCLE2: a thin Moroccan man in his 40s with slicked-back hair, wearing a black leather jacket and grey trousers
chars.DOCTOR: a Moroccan female doctor with glasses, white coat and a stethoscope

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a tiny poor kitchen in Rabat, MOTHER suddenly collapses against the wall holding her chest, FATIMA rushes to catch her, terrified

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a crowded public hospital room, DOCTOR with a serious face shows a scan to MOTHER sitting on a bed; FATIMA stands beside, holding her mother's hand, shocked

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a small bare room with a thin mattress on the floor, MOTHER lies pale and weak under a blanket while FATIMA feeds her soup with a spoon, worried

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow street of the Rabat medina, FATIMA supports her weak MOTHER by the arm as they walk slowly toward a big wooden door

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a rich Moroccan salon with sofas and a tea tray, UNCLE and UNCLE2 sit comfortably and look coldly and greedily at MOTHER and FATIMA standing at the doorway

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the rich salon, MOTHER kneels on the carpet in front of UNCLE seated on the sofa, begging with tears, bending toward his feet; FATIMA watches from behind, heartbroken

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the rich salon, UNCLE2 leans forward and points his finger at kneeling MOTHER, saying something harsh with a cruel smile

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the rich salon, MOTHER cries with her hands open, pleading, while UNCLE looks away with a cold face, sipping mint tea

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the rich salon, UNCLE points at FATIMA who stands frozen and scared by the door clutching her hoodie sleeves; he looks at her like he is deciding her fate
